note: TAGS1 frozen rules (owner yes 2026-11-18; research/crunch/WAVE1.md #4). Journal-only would-skip tags: NO order, slot, latch or halt changes. Frozen 2026-11-18 before any fresh session; scored ONCE after 20 fresh sessions (2026-11-19 .. 2026-12-17, 11-26 closed). Thresholds are copied from the Wave 1 sources and must not be edited before the score. Educational only - not financial advice.

FLAT25.desc: skip while |SPY from its open| < 0.25% at the decision

STACK1_L3X.desc: skip a new RW3-FD / RW5-FD lot while another Primary lot is open on the same symbol (L3-gap-slope-fromopen-FD exempt)

MFGAP.desc: MF-family (open-flowsell) short on a stock whose open gapped up >= 2%

W4_HFL_VWAP.desc: heat_fade_long*: skip if side-adjusted (price - VWAP) / ATR > -0.209

W4_NS3_PDAY.desc: NS3*: skip if the prior day's return > +1.357%

W4_L3_PM.desc: L3-gap-slope*: record tag for entries 13:30-15:00 ET (tod 240-330 min)

W4_RW3_GAP2.desc: RW3*: record tag for a gap below -2%

score.method: per rule: R after costs (LR8 basis) of the would-skip trades; excess over random removal of the same number of trades from the same setups (>= 95th percentile of 2,000 draws); day-clustered t; avg R w/o best day; per-setup better / worse counts; Primary scope uses Primary live trades, 'all' uses every account de-duplicated (setup|symbol|date|minute)
